The structure of Lu8Au4Pt4 (reduced formula Lu2AuPt) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/nmm (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Au and Pt each as six-coordinate octahedral centers, while Lu shows a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Au and Pt octahedra and face-sharing between Au octahedra and Lu 12-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites.
